run_video_retrieval: run the video retrieval pipeline with video encoder to compute video-to-video retrieval benchmarks
init_model_datasets: init the video encoder model and datasets for video retrieval evaluation
load_or_get_features: load or extract video features from train and test datasets using the video encoder model
average_features: average video features across frames to get mean feature per video for retrieval
run_retrieval_benchmark: run video-to-video retrieval benchmark using train and val features with labels and indices
